name: SMS Notifications / Order Notification WooCommerce / Login & Register with Phone
author: miniOrange

sections.description:
Features | Setup Guide | Contact Us

SMS Notifications / Order Notification WooCommerce / Login & Register with Phone

WooCommerce SMS Notifications plugin allows you to send Order Notifications and Order Status updates via SMS and WhatsApp to customers, admins, and vendors. It supports WCFM Vendor Forms, and the WooCommerce Product Vendor Registration Form and OTP Verification on Forms such as WooCommerce Registration, WooCommerce Login, WooCommerce Checkout, Password Reset, and Billing Address.
With features like Order Status Notifications via SMS & WhatsApp, Vendor Alerts (WCFM, Dokan), WooCommerce Checkout OTP, Password Reset via OTP, and Stock Notifications, it boosts both security and communication across your WooCommerce store. It enables phone number login, registration, and OTP verification on supported forms.

Check more about Order Notification / SMS Notifications / Login & Register with Phone

WooCommerce Notifications

The WooCommerce SMS Notifications plugin allows your site to send automated Order Status updates and Order Notifications via SMS and WhatsApp to customers, admins, and vendors. These alerts are automatically triggered upon changes in WooCommerce order or payment status. This enhances your WooCommerce store’s customer experience with real-time SMS notifications for every order status update.

  • WooCommerce Order Status Notifications
  • WCFM Vendor Notifications
  • Dokan Vendor Notifications
  • Notifications on Submission of Forms
  • Notifications on User Registration
  • Back In stock Notifications*

We support the below WooCommerce SMS Notifications for the Admins, Customers, and Vendors*:

  • New Customer Registration Notification.
  • New Order Notification.
  • Order Cancellation Notification.
  • Order Fulfillment Notification.
  • Order Payment Notification.
  • Order Deletion Notification.
  • WooCommerce Low Stock & Out of Stock Notifications.
  • Refund Status Notification.

[WooCommerce SMS Notifications and OTP Verification on WordPress](https://blog.miniorange.com/otp-verification/)

Key Features

👉 Login with Phone & Registration with Phone
👉 WooCommerce order status notifications to customers, admins, and vendors
👉 WCFM Vendor Notifications
👉 Dokan Vendor Notifications
👉 WooCommerce Stock Notifications.
👉 Notifications on Submission of WooCommerce forms.
👉 Login and Register Using Phone
👉 OTP Verification on all WooCommerce forms*.
👉 Country code dropdown for the phone fields
👉 WooCommerce Password Reset over OTP verification
👉 Custom SMS/SMTP Gateway like Twilio, MSG91, AWS SNS Gateways are Supported.
👉 WhatsApp Notifications
👉 WhatsApp OTP verification
👉 Passwordless login with phone
👉 OTP Verification on Selected WooCommerce product category.

Follow this guide to Setup SMS Notifications, Order Notifications & OTP Verification on your WooCommerce site: Guide
Contact us at otpsupport@xecurify.com to know more.

Which forms can be used with OTP verification and SMS/WhatsApp notifications?

The WooCommerce OTP Verification plugin provides OTP Verification using Phone and Email on WooCommerce Login/ Registration/ Password reset/ Checkout forms.

  • WooCommerce Login form OTP verification during WooCommerce site login. Log in using only your phone number. Passwordless login through OTP.
  • WooCommerce registration form OTP verification on the WooCommerce site on new user registration. Registration using a phone number only is supported.
  • WooCommerce checkout form OTP verification when the user places an order on the WooCommerce site.
  • WooCommerce Frontend Manager form OTP verification on the Multivendor form for Bookings and listing of WooCommerce frontend Manager.
  • WooCommerce Social Login form Enable OTP verification on the Social Login for seamless checkout and account creation with a layer of security.
  • WooCommerce Product Vendor Registration Form OTP verification on the vendor registration forms on the WooCommerce store manager page.
  • WooCommerce Billing Address Form Enabled OTP verification when users changes the billing address.
  • Checkout WC Form: Enables OTP verification when users proceed with the checkout on the Checkout WC form.
  • WooCommerce Account Details Form: Enables OTP verification when a user changes the phone number or email address on the account page.
  • WooCommerce Password Reset Form: OTP verification when user reset their password using WooCommerce password reset page.
  • Dokan – Best WooCommerce Multivendor Marketplace: OTP Verification on Dokan Vendor Registration form. (For customers & vendors)

WOOCOMMERCE ADDITIONAL FEATURE LIST

  • WhatsApp Order Notifications & WhatsApp OTP Verification :
    Send OTPs and order notifications directly over WhatsApp using your own personal WhatsApp Business account, ensuring faster delivery and a more personalized customer experience.

  • Register using Phone Number only :
    Enable users to register on your WooCommerce site using only their phone number, eliminating the need for an email address and simplifying the registration process.

  • WCFM Multivendor Notifications :
    Send real-time order status update notifications to store vendors via SMS, keeping them informed about new orders, cancellations, and status changes to ensure timely processing.

  • Dokan Vendor Notifications :
    Send SMS notifications to vendors whenever there’s a WooCommerce order status update, ensuring they stay informed about new orders, cancellations, and progress in real-time.

  • OTP Verification on Selected WooCommerce Product Category :
    Enable OTP verification specifically for selected WooCommerce product categories, adding an extra layer of security for high-risk or premium products during checkout or user actions.

  • Limit OTP Request :
    Limit OTP Request helps prevent misuse by restricting the number of OTP requests a user can make within a specific time frame, protecting against spam and malicious attempts.

  • Login with Phone Number :
    Allow users to log in to your WooCommerce site using only their phone number, eliminating the need for a username or email and streamlining the login experience.

  • WooCommerce Password Reset Over OTP :
    Allow users to reset their password securely by verifying their identity through an OTP sent to their registered phone number or email address.

How does this plugin work?

  1. Once the order is placed on the WooCommerce website the customer and admin will receive the SMS notifications of order status updates.
  2. SMS Notification will be sent automatically once order status changes.
  3. Users will need to verify their Phone Number/Email address before submitting the form.
  4. Once OTP is verified, the user can submit the form.

How is this plugin better than other plugins available?

  1. Send SMS Notifications to the customers, admins, and vendors for order status updates and much more!
  2. Verification of the user’s Phone Number or Email address during registration and login is a must these days. You can easily enable OTP verification on your login registration form using a plugin.
  3. WhatsApp order notifications and OTP Verification.
  4. WooCommerce SMS Order Status Notifications.
  5. Easy setup: Guide
  6. World Class 24/7 Support.

SUPPORT

24*7 customer support is available.
For new feature requests or any queries, you can use WordPress support forum.
Email us at otpsupport@xecurify.com/info@xecurify.com.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for WooCommerce SMS notifications. Find and Install SMS Notifications / Order Notification WooCommerce / Login & Register with Phone
  3. Activate the plugin from your Plugins page

From WordPress.org

  1. Download miniOrange SMS Notifications / Order Notification WooCommerce / Login & Register with Phone.
  2. Unzip and upload the miniorange-sms-order-notification-otp-verification directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate Order Notification on WooCommerce from your Plugins page.
sections.faq:
*Why OTP verification is required during WooCommerce registration?**

OTP verification during WooCommerce registration ensures that users provide a valid phone number while registering on your WooCommerce site. This prevents fake sign-ups. It enables SMS Notifications for order updates, password resets, and WhatsApp Notifications. It also allows seamless registration using Login & Register with Phone, WooCommerce Checkout, and Password Reset without relying on email or SMTP configuration.

*Which forms are supported by the SMS notification/ order notification plugin?**

WooCommerce Registration Form, WooCommerce Login Form, WooCommerce Checkout Form, WooCommerce Password Reset Form, WooCommerce Billing Address Form, WCFM Vendor Forms, WooCommerce Product Vendor Registration Form.

*Can customers log in using only their phone number**

Yes, the plugin supports passwordless login. Customers can log in using just their phone number with OTP verification, eliminating the need to remember passwords

*Can I notify vendors and admins about new orders?**

Yes, the plugin allows you to send real-time SMS and WhatsApp notifications to vendors and admins whenever a new order is placed, ensuring smooth order management.

*I want support for other forms with customized features. Is it possible?**

Yes, It is possible to get customized features on the other forms.
To get support for custom forms or a plugin-designed form, please email us at otpsupport@xecurify.com/info@xecurify.com with a brief description of your form. You can also submit your query from the plugin’s settings page.
